summary: git_archive and the candidate diff/blob scans honor repository-local refs/replace, so the archived tree can differ from the commit OID being attested.
failure_scenario: A checkout holds a local `git replace <candidate-oid> <other-commit>` ref; clean_git_environment strips GIT_* (including GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS) and never passes --no-replace-objects, so `git archive <candidate-oid>` packages the replacement's tree, while the gate reports and records the original OID and diff hash.
evidence: Built a two-commit scratch repo (good vs evil f.txt), ran `git replace`, then called release_gate._resolved_commit_oid (returned the original OID) and git_archive for that OID: extracted f.txt was 'evil', while `git --no-replace-objects show <oid>:f.txt` is 'good'. canonical_candidate_diff_sha256 and scan_git_blobs use the same unguarded git calls. Other modules (candidate_source_archive_oracle.py:1310, tests/generation_source.py:57) already pass --no-replace-objects, so the gate is inconsistent with the repo's own source-integrity convention.

summary: The candidate_dirty check trusts `git status` run under ambient repository-local config, so a hidden local setting makes a dirty candidate look clean.
failure_scenario: With `status.showUntrackedFiles=no` in .git/config, or an assume-unchanged/skip-worktree bit on a tracked file, `git status --porcelain=v1` prints nothing although an extra untracked .py exists or a tracked file was edited; verify_runtime passes candidate_dirty and the wheel/source comparison proceeds against a tree that is not the pinned commit. The git() helper at line 174 uses no -c overrides, no --no-replace-objects, and keeps GIT_* from the environment. `HEAD^{tree}` at line 258 also honors refs/replace.
evidence: In a scratch repo, set status.showUntrackedFiles=no and added an untracked file, then marked a tracked file assume-unchanged and edited it. Plain git status and setup_lookup_backend.git(path,'status','--porcelain=v1') both returned ''. Replace-object part of the claim is by construction from the same mechanism as the release_gate finding, not separately run. The same unguarded pattern appears at scripts/rehearse_desktop_mvp.py:1240 (harness_matches_head, `git diff --quiet HEAD`), not separately run.
